title: Devlog #2 Newtonian Frontier (Working Title)
author: According-Pressure39
selftext:
Hello everyone,

Second Devlog for me now, showing you my Project and what i gave been working on this Week. 

>**Imortant !!!!**   
EVERYTHING SEEN HERE WILL CHANGE AT ANY MOMENT, THIS IS A PASSION PROJECT AND I WILL FOCUS ON BRINGING A POLISHED PRODUCT.

1. **Main Menu with new Background.** Finally i decided i needed some kind of Menu so i could Start the game , Save Load and Quit the game. And of course host a game for Multiplayer

https://i.redd.it/rfls7ebtj7zh1.png

  
2. **A new Frigate: Freja**  I decided i needed some more ships to test Combat and NPC Ship behavior. So i creates more ships (one of those is the Freja) 

https://i.redd.it/nuchcmegk7zh1.png

>Btw the Menus are not done yet, and im Hiring a UI creator and i have a really nice additions for Later.

3. **VFX Additions (small ones)** i added some VFX so i could see if the RCS Thrusters on every ship worked without allways going into debug mode. 

![img](zsgt2ys4l7zh1 "Warp VFX")

![img](jogn7ywxk7zh1 "Non Warp VFX")

**WHAT IS GOING TO BE DONE NEXT?**

>**My small adjustments with Save files and small additions are done. I will focus on following things.** 

* ***Ressources and related Products. (120)*** 
* ***Real Economy driven by players and NPC***
* ***NPC Decisions***
* ***A Rocket Launcher Module***
* ***Better UI Elements***
* ***Space POI´s and Missions***
* ***Academy for Skill learning***

If you have any suggestions feel free to write me and if you like follow my official r/NewtonianFrontier Channel
